 WMOK: WHO’S HIRING!? Shawnee Development Council, Inc. is hiring a Temporary LIHEAP Verifier / Intake Worker for their Massac County office
 / WMOK 
 WMOK - Metropolis, IL 
 Oct 19, 2026 | 10:23 AM 
 Position: Temporary LIHEAP Verifier / Intake Worker 
 Salary: $27,755.00 – $30,940.00 
 Key Benefits: 
 Summers off 
 35-hour work week 
 Works September through May 
 Fridays off at 1:00 PM 
 Paid holidays after 90 days and prorated PTO 
 Role Overview: Reviews applications taken by outreach office staff across service areas, understands program rules from intake to payment, secures proper documentation, and makes phone contacts with outreach offices, customers, and vendors . 
 How to Apply: Applications are available online or at your local SDC office . Shawnee Development Council Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer .
